_note: Scripted Risk flags for vendor-agreement-03, an Indian card machine agreement modelled on First American with the $495 exit fee given as Rs. 42,000 (about $495 at roughly Rs. 85 to the dollar). Every Default Red line is seeded; Red line 3 is seeded as terms 'as amended from time to time'. Several Red line matches are scripted below Don't sign as written on purpose. Red lines 2 and 4 cite two sentences each.

riskFlags.title: Three-year minimum term
riskFlags.says: The minimum term is three years from the date the card machine is installed.
sourceSentences: The minimum term of this Agreement is three years from the date the card machine is installed.

riskFlags.title: Automatic renewal, and Rs. 42,000 to leave
riskFlags.says: After the minimum term the agreement renews by itself for a year at a time unless Meera Sweets gives written notice at least sixty days before a renewal date. Ending it before the minimum term or a renewal period is over costs Rs. 42,000.
sourceSentences: After the minimum term, this Agreement renews automatically for successive periods of one year unless Merchant gives written notice at least sixty days before a renewal date.
If Merchant ends this Agreement before the end of the minimum term or of any renewal period, Merchant will pay Provider an exit fee of Rs. 42,000.

riskFlags.title: Charges as amended from time to time by Provider
riskFlags.says: The 1.8% fee on each card sale and the Rs. 450 monthly rental both apply as amended from time to time by Sanchay.
sourceSentences: Merchant will pay a fee of 1.8% of each card sale and a machine rental of Rs. 450 a month, both as amended from time to time by Provider.

riskFlags.title: Partner's personal guarantee
riskFlags.says: Meera Kulkarni personally guarantees every amount Meera Sweets owes under the agreement.
sourceSentences: Meera Kulkarni, a partner of Merchant, personally guarantees the payment of every amount Merchant owes under this Agreement.

riskFlags.title: Indemnity for every card transaction
riskFlags.says: Meera Sweets covers Sanchay against all claims, penalties and losses from any card transaction at its shop, and this liability is not limited to the charges it has paid.
riskFlags.judgment: No cap appears in the document.
sourceSentences: Merchant will indemnify Provider against all claims, penalties and losses arising from any card transaction at Merchant's shop.
Merchant's liability under this clause is not limited to the charges paid under this Agreement.
